title: document.text from installed pdftotext, and DEP-5 licenses for acquired system binaries
problem: GREG cannot check a fact inside a PDF; acquired system binaries carry no license assessment.
baseline: #201 head 1d9d873: no document function; binary card says 'license not inspected by GREG'.

alternatives.name: Proposed: pdftotext through the existing binary route + GREG PDF oracle + DEP-5
alternatives.description: Commodity binary, frozen oracle, read-root checks and binary hash pin inherited from the existing route.
advantages: Reuses the route sha256sum and wc already use

alternatives.name: pypdf package route
alternatives.description: Pure-Python BSD-3 package through the DEPEND route.
disadvantages: Needs a file-reading package contract in Genesis (read roots inside normalize)
alternatives.revival_evidence: First body without poppler where the founder declines apt install

alternatives.name: Build a PDF parser
disadvantages: Rebuilds commodity; PDF is a large format

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Missions cannot read PDFs; binaries remain license-blind.

roles.position: Real everyday function (contracts, invoices) from commodity software, not rebuilt.
material_concerns: Must not claim OCR or layout understanding

roles.position: One catalog entry and one parser on the existing binary route; no new registry.
Oracle cross-checked on two unrelated engines; negative cases assert their causes.
material_concerns: Oracle could be tuned to poppler
evidence_refs: 0 mismatches poppler and PDFium over 120 PDFs

roles.position: No dependency added; the founder installs poppler on a body that lacks it.
material_concerns: Chromebook body lacks poppler by default

roles.position: Licenses read from declarations; binaries with known not-open licenses never auto-attach.

evidence.claim: Mission closes on a PDF's words
evidence.finding: ACHIEVED with real pdftotext; fails on 1d9d873

counterevidence.finding: false: GFDL documentation licenses would have stopped sha256sum on every Debian body

pass_1.intended_outcome: Missions can verify facts in PDFs; acquired binaries carry their declared license.

advantages.statement: Any mission family can now check documents
advantages.amplified_value: Contracts, invoices and reports become verifiable evidence for missions and organs

disadvantages.redesigned_response: Escalation names the install; pypdf route recorded

disadvantages.statement: Oracle might be tuned to one engine

disadvantages.redesigned_response: Hold only known not-cleared; label unknown

comparisons.simplest_viable_alternative: pdftotext on the existing binary route (selected)
comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: pypdf package route with a file contract
comparisons.reversible_experiment: catalog entry removable; card field inert

pass_2.attack_summary: Attack the oracle's independence, the baseline's honesty, the binary license asymmetry and the read-root boundary.

new_weaknesses.statement: Uncompressed oracle PDFs let fs.read find words, inflating the dividend
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Oracle and tests use Flate-compressed PDFs; baseline asserted on a compressed PDF
Classify GFDL variants; hold binaries only on known not-cleared classes

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: two unrelated engines agree with the oracle
stated asymmetry avoids a regression with no legal basis
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: a binary with an unclassified license is acquired

pass_2.final_design: document.text on the binary route with the compressed-PDF oracle; DEP-5 reader; attach_check at both attach points.

residual_risks.review_trigger: first mission over a scanned PDF

dissent.handling: No dissent recorded; the binary asymmetry is an accepted, stated risk.

migration_plan: Additive catalog entry and card fields; no data migration.
kill_criteria: A PDF check closes a mission when the document lacks the phrase
The reader returns content from outside the read roots
